headline: xAI says Grok Bot update adds credential Vault and broadens agent actions
summary: An October 23 changelog for Grok Bot v0.75.5 says Bots can store logins, payment cards and contact details in a Vault and fill them at sign-in or checkout. The update also adds email forwarding and says Auto Review asks less often for requested actions; requested email and Slack messages send after Auto Review allows them, while routine and other-turn sends remain drafts. These are vendor-described features, not independently tested outcomes. xAI documentation says payment confirmations still require user handoff and describes Auto Review as model-based.
